title: SatOps-Decision: Low-Latency Discriminative Decisions for Onboard Satellite Communication Operations
abstract: arXiv:2610.38697v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose SatOps-Decision, a method for low-latency decisions in satellite communication operations. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first application of Jev-style general-purpose discriminative decision models to satellite operations, and the accompanying benchmark is the first dedicated to this approach. The learned scorer, a locally adapted Laya encoder with its native decision head, selects among supplied operational answers in a single forward pass. The benchmark combines authored operational contracts, controlled state changes and independently checked labels in an auditable construction. Evaluation prioritizes complete-request latency and raw decision accuracy; all main accuracy comparisons use the same 1,024 held-out questions, separate from training and development. SatOps-Decision's local scorer has a median latency of 90.3 ms per decision, versus 493.9 ms for Qwen3.5-0.8B generation and 388.4 ms for OneJev1.6-0.8B:

translated_title: SatOps-Decision：面向星载卫星通信运营的低延迟判别式决策
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SatOps-Decision，一种用于卫星通信运营中低延迟决策的方法。据我们所知，这是Jev风格通用判别式决策模型在卫星运营中的首次应用，且随附的基准测试是首个专门针对这一方法的基准。该经过学习的评分器是一个本地适配的Laya编码器及其原生决策头，可在单次前向传播中从给定的运营答案中进行选择。该基准以可审计的构建方式，结合了人工编写的运营合约、受控的状态变化以及经过独立核查的标签。评估优先考虑完整请求延迟和原始决策准确率；所有主要准确率比较均使用相同的1,024个保留问题，且与训练和开发数据相分离。SatOps-Decision的本地评分器每次决策的中位延迟为90.3毫秒，相比之下，Qwen3.5-0.8B生成方式为493.9毫秒，OneJev1.6-0.8B为388.4毫秒。
tldr: SatOps-Decision首次将Jev风格通用判别式决策模型应用于卫星通信运营，通过本地评分器单次前向传播即可完成决策，每次决策中位延迟仅90.3毫秒，远低于生成式方法，并配有首个专门的基准测试。
en_tdlr: SatOps-Decision is the first application of Jev-style general-purpose discriminative decision models to satellite communication operations, selecting operational answers in a single forward pass with a median latency of 90.3 ms per decision—significantly faster than generative approaches—along with the first dedicated benchmark for this approach.
